name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person: broken arrangements, trust money, statute dates, disputes, quiet accounts

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: From v_attention. Days are counted from the date shown; negative means still to come.
sections.sql: select ref, owner, item, detail, date, days from v_attention order by days desc nulls last

sections.title: Contact rule findings
sections.note: Each contact checked against docs/compliance.md. Times are the debtor's local time.
sections.sql: select ref, owner, to_char(local_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as local_time, channel, rule, severity, finding from v_contact_findings order by local_at desc

sections.title: Open tasks
sections.sql: select a.ref, t.title, t.owner, t.due_on from tasks t join accounts a on a.id = t.account_id where t.done_on is null order by t.due_on nulls last

name: book
title: The book
subtitle: Every open account by client, with arrangements and limitation dates

sections.title: Open accounts
sections.sql: select b.client, b.ref, b.debtor, b.state, b.status, b.collector, b.currency, b.balance_cents, b.paid_cents, b.last_tried_on, l.barred_on from v_balances b join v_limitation l on l.account_id = b.account_id where b.status not in ('paid','returned','closed') order by b.client, b.ref

sections.title: Arrangements
sections.sql: select ref, owner, kind, every, instalments, currency, amount_cents, next_due, expected_cents, paid_cents, state from v_arrangements where status = 'active' order by state, next_due

sections.title: Limitation dates in the next 180 days
sections.note: Statute-barred debts: never state or imply legal action (RG 96 part 2 s 20).
sections.sql: select ref, debtor, state, status, currency, balance_cents, runs_from, barred_on from v_limitation where balance_cents > 0 and status not in ('paid','returned','closed') and barred_on <= current_date + 180 order by barred_on

name: money
title: Trust and commission
subtitle: Money held for each client, commission earned and remittances made

sections.title: Held in trust, not yet remitted
sections.sql: select client, name, currency, trust_cents, direct_cents, commission_cents, oldest_trust_on, remit_days, last_remitted_on from v_trust order by trust_cents desc

sections.title: Remittances
sections.sql: select r.ref, c.code as client, r.period_to, r.made_on, c.currency, r.trust_cents, r.commission_cents, r.gst_cents, r.net_cents, r.reference from remittances r join clients c on c.id = r.client_id order by r.made_on desc
